prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Move to object, take and move to the destination. Check object properties, avoid obstacles. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = DropObject    /> <Action ID = TurnLeft    /> <Action ID = TurnRight    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObstacleInFront    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    />  <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
